summary: This video showcases two top-performing Frost team compositions for the Season 8 Phase 1 endgame boss, Mekkatorque, capable of dealing over 1 billion damage. The first build is F2P-friendly with low inspiration requirements using Lossenia, Aethereal, Vitar, Olgan, and Feenja to achieve 1.2 billion damage. Replacing Feenja with Anselmo boosts the team's damage up to 1.5 billion. Proper gearing, high Accuracy, and carefully tuned Skill Haste for aligned 15-second skill rotations are crucial for maximizing damage output.

heroes.name: Lossenia
heroes.note: Requires around 500 Accuracy and Mystic Conch to share Accuracy and apply debuffs consistently.

heroes.name: Aethereal
heroes.note: Build with over 500 Enlightenment, high Attack, and proper Skill Haste to align with 15-second rotations.

heroes.name: Vitar
heroes.note: Built for Derivative damage with Attack, Accuracy, and Skill Haste to share damage stats.

heroes.name: Olgan
heroes.note: Equipped with the Puppeteer set and Golden Antler to share Attack and Accuracy with the team.

heroes.name: Feenja
heroes.note: Built with high Skill Haste (~125), Resistance, Enlightenment, and Resistance-sharing talent.

heroes.name: Anselmo
heroes.note: Pushes team damage to 1.5B with high Skill Haste (~126), Secrecy set, and debuff prolongation talent.

teams.note: F2P-friendly Frost lineup reaching 1.2B damage using 0-inspiration characters and aligned 15s rotations.
High-output Frost lineup reaching 1.5B damage by using Anselmo to extend debuffs and boost team DPS.

tips: Tune Skill Haste across all heroes to ensure skill activations align on a clean 15-second rotation.
Build Lossenia with 500+ Accuracy and Mystic Conch to ensure debuffs land reliably and Accuracy is shared.
Equip Olgan with the Puppeteer set and Golden Antler artifact to maximize team Attack sharing.
title: Best Frost Teams vs Mekkatorque | S8 Endgame Boss Phase 1 | Dragonheir
